crossRefs.note: Shout for joy to Yahweh, all you lands!
I will extol you, Yahweh, for you have raised me up, and have not made my foes to rejoice over me.
Sing to God! Sing praises to his name! Extol him who rides on the clouds: to Yah, his name! Rejoice before him!
But I will always hope, and will add to all of your praise.
Praise Yahweh, my soul! All that is within me, praise his holy name!
Praise Yahweh, my soul, and don’t forget all his benefits,
Now I, Nebuchadnezzar, praise and extol and honor the King of heaven; for all his works are truth, and his ways…
You are my King, God. Command victories for Jacob!
My heart overflows with a noble theme. I recite my verses for the king. My tongue is like the pen of a skillful writer.
Your throne, God, is forever and ever. A scepter of equity is the scepter of your kingdom.
Sing praises to God! Sing praises! Sing praises to our King! Sing praises!
Beautiful in elevation, the joy of the whole earth, is Mount Zion, on the north sides, the city of the great King.
God has shown himself in her citadels as a refuge.
For Yahweh is a great God, a great King above all gods.
Let Israel rejoice in him who made them. Let the children of Zion be joyful in their King.
For Yahweh is our judge. Yahweh is our lawgiver. Yahweh is our king. He will save us.
“But the deceiver is cursed, who has in his flock a male, and vows, and sacrifices to the Lord a defective thing; for I…
Then the King will tell those on his right hand, ‘Come, blessed of my Father, inherit the Kingdom prepared for you from…
He has on his garment and on his thigh a name written, “KING OF KINGS, AND LORD OF LORDS.”
My mouth will speak the praise of Yahweh. Let all flesh bless his holy name forever and ever.
to the end that my heart may sing praise to you, and not be silent. Yahweh my God, I will give thanks to you forever!
I will give you thanks forever, because you have done it. I will hope in your name, for it is good, in the presence of…
Praise Yah! Praise, you servants of Yahweh, praise Yahweh’s name.
Blessed be Yahweh’s name, from this time forward and forever more.
Praise Yah! Praise Yahweh, my soul.
While I live, I will praise Yahweh. I will sing praises to my God as long as I exist.

parallels.note: Yahweh will reign forever and ever.”

translations.web: I will exalt you, my God, the King. I will praise your name forever and ever.
translations.bsb: I will exalt You, my God and King; I will bless Your name forever and ever.
translations.kjv: I will extol thee, my God, O king; and I will bless thy name for ever and ever.
translations.asv: I will extol thee, my God, O King; And I will bless thy name for ever and ever.
